children: RNS Number : 8573T  Foresight Solar Fund Limited  08 September 2026

Foresight Solar, the fund investing in solar and battery storage assets to generate income and deliver long-term growth, announces the appointment of Antonia Burgess as an Independent Non-Executive Director. The appointment has effect from 8 September 2026.

Mrs Burgess has more than 30 years of experience working in the legal and financial services sectors. An experienced Jersey resident independent non-executive director, she has worked with reputable fund managers and investment companies. She is a qualified English solicitor and, before relocating to Jersey, she worked for a leading international law firm in London.

Commenting on the appointment Tony Roper, Chair of Foresight Solar, said: "We are delighted to welcome Antonia to the Board of Foresight Solar. She brings significant experience that will strengthen the Board's capabilities as we continue to oversee the delivery of the Company's income and growth strategy.
"Her appointment adds valuable skills, particularly in risk management, and re-establishes a Jersey-based majority of Directors, reflecting Foresight Solar's long-standing governance arrangements.
"We look forward to working with Antonia as we continue to oversee the Company's performance and support the delivery of long-term value for shareholders."
On her appointment to the Board, Mrs Burgess will also join the Audit and Risk, Management Engagement, Nomination and Remuneration Committees.

Mrs Burgess currently serves on the board of Phoenix Spree Deutschland Limited, a Jersey-incorporated investment company listed on the London Stock Exchange. She acts as Senior Independent Director, chairing both the Risk and the Remuneration Committees.
In accordance with the Listing Rules, no further information is required to be disclosed on behalf of Mrs Burgess pursuant to UKLR 6.4.8R.
